publication_boundary: Digitised and published means every located control copy has a live rendered public text-edition PDF/pages, a raster-only irreversibly redacted source facsimile, redacted source-page images and a manifest. Seventeen packages contain privacy-checked redacted OCR; the three fully withheld packages contain page-sequenced redaction markers backed by separately controlled private automated OCR custody. The 158-resource exact-byte readback passed against the reviewed publication tree.
It does not mean that OCR is certified, that the received copy is an official minute book or certified original, or that every source variant and annex has been found.
Every package retains complete_public_text=false and manual_source_line_verification=false.

Documented convener/body is separate from attributed perimeter. Adverse-lane labels are Gil Marer's attributed position, not findings of joint conduct, fraud, criminal purpose or guilt; project-side lineage does not attribute pre-entry acts to Gil.
The standalone 20 November 2018 ACTA remains unlocated.

The received five-page RICPE shareholder document is dated 11 February 2022 and attributes a proposed call and agenda to the RICPE board through its secretary. It proves received wording and byte custody only, not authorship, actual issuance, service, recipient knowledge or that the scheduled 11/12 March 2022 meeting occurred, reached quorum, voted or produced minutes; the primary 29 December 2021 meeting records mentioned in the document also remain unlocated.
The five-page president statement referenced by the located 10 August 2012 ACTA is now located; the separate written objection remains unlocated.
Unredacted native sources, signatures, personal identifiers, banking data and private owner details remain outside the public repository.
